_comment: Published datasets. `precedence` lists sources from most to least preferred: when several sources report the same (reporter, partner, flow, product, freq, period), the first one wins. `freqs` lists the frequencies to publish with their first year. Trailing periods where fewer than `min_coverage` (share of the best-covered period's reporters) have reported are dropped, so incomplete recent months don't look like a collapse.
